spell.mousesmagics.dew_drop.guide: Blast out a dew drop. On hit, gain boosted mana regen for a few seconds.
spell.mousesmagics.bliss.guide: Grants you Calm. Calm lowers mana regen for boosted power and stronger magical resistance.
spell.mousesmagics.blessing_of_spirit.gu: Bless a target, granting them mana.
spell.mousesmagics.bulwark_of_blossoms.g: Create an impenetrable shield of flower, giving you a split second of invulnerability.
spell.mousesmagics.drip.guide: Call down a barrage of dew in front of you. Each hit grants extra mana.
spell.mousesmagics.floral_spear.guide: Shoot forth a highly damaging spear of flowers, levitating anything hit.
spell.mousesmagics.flower_dance.guide: Dance with the power of blossoms, applying lower defence and levitation to anything around you.
spell.mousesmagics.petal_on_the_wind.gui: Dash forth through the wind, with multiple recasts.
spell.mousesmagics.protective_film.guide: Grant you, and all near you, an effect which lowers gravity.
